key_highlights: ASX records fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equity valuations
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor opens'), raising import costs and commodity export revenue
Housing prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline; more than half of renters financially stressed
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags urgent need for tax reform amid fiscal pressure
Active ASX small-cap exploration: gold (Aurum, Zenith, Auric, Kuniko) and copper (Rio2) drilling results positive
$2.7B cap raise wave pressures ASX small/mid-caps; brokers under strain
Data centre energy demand threatens power supply stability, impacting energy sector

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust: gold hits at Aurum (155g/t), Zenith (6/6 in WA), Auric (Munda), Kuniko (NSW); Rio2 copper drilling in Peru. However, cap raise flood ($2.7B) dilutes small-cap holders. AUD weakness boosts export earnings for BHP, RIO, FMG.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) benefit from AUD depreciation and commodity pricing. Small-cap explorers face dilution risk from cap raises despite positive drill results. Gold names (WPM.AX, NGX.AX) supported by safe-haven flows amid geopolitical tension.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite unemployment surge pressures NIMs but raises default risk. Intergenerational Report signals potential tax reform. Star casino licence suspension hits gaming revenue. Bond yield climb pressures equity multiples.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression from rate pincer. Rising unemployment increases credit losses. Bond yield climb (headline 60) threatens financial valuations. Gaming (STAR.AX) under regulatory pressure.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom creating energy supply constraints ('energy bust'). Power demand structural shift. Energy security becomes policy priority.
sectors.implications: Energy producers (SME.AX, WDS.AX, AGL.AX) benefit from sustained demand. Grid operators and renewable developers gain policy tailwind. Data centre operators face cost inflation.

sectors.trend: Housing prices over halfway to 40-year decline. CBD commercial property under pressure (lending library tower listed at $40m). Renter stress at 50%+ signals tenant demand softening.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICV.AX) face occupancy and rental yield pressure. Residential construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) may see delayed demand. Commercial REITs under valuation pressure.

sectors.trend: Adelaide hospital ED strain signals public health system stress. Medicare data breach prompts AI safety legislation. Consumer staples under pressure from interest rate pincer and renter stress.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face mixed signals. Healthcare infrastructure spend likely to increase. Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX) pressured by household financial stress.

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race intensifies (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, SK Hynix). Australian small-caps (Micro-X, Mamba) in ASX runners. AI safety regulation emerging domestically.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited but global AI capex cycle supports hardware supply chains. AI regulation (Medicare breach response) may create compliance cost headwinds for local tech.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot vs. rising unemployment creates stagflationary risk
Bond yield climb threatens equity valuations across ASX
AUD depreciation: positive for miners, negative for importers and consumers
Housing market correction deepens; 40-year low trajectory
ASX small-cap cap raise dilution wave ($2.7B)
Geopolitical risk (Ukraine, US-China) supports safe-haven flows
Energy demand structural shift from data centres

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike despite unemployment surge
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration exposure; favour rate-sensitive sectors (banks, REITs) only on yield spread widening. Hedge with short-duration bonds.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike crashing equity valuations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift allocation toward cash, short bonds, and dividend-paying large caps. Avoid high-multiple growth names.
Overweight commodity exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX). Underweight import-dependent consumer staples.
Underweight property REITs and construction. Monitor bank NPL trends. Favour defensive consumer staples.
Avoid micro-cap explorers with pending raises. Focus on funded, producing assets. Monitor $2.7B raise pipeline.
Maintain 10-15% allocation to gold (WPM.AX, NGX.AX) and energy hedges. Diversify geographically.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap miners on AUD weakness and commodity pricing
opportunities.rationale: AUD depreciation directly boosts AUD-denominated earnings for iron ore, copper, and gold producers. Geopolitical risk supports gold.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy and grid infrastructure on data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from data centres creates multi-year revenue visibility for generators and grid operators.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap gold explorers with funded drill programmes
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive drill results (Aurum, Zenith, Auric, Kuniko) in WA/NSW suggest exploration upside, but avoid dilution from cap raises.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce equity duration; shift to short-duration bonds and cash
defensive_moves.rationale: Fourth consecutive ASX losing week on rising yields signals further downside. Bond yield spike risk to equities is elevated.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and residential construction
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing prices over halfway to 40-year decline; renter stress at 50%+ signals demand deterioration. CBD commercial listings rising.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented earnings
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' depreciation raises import costs and pressures consumer discretionary. Export earners benefit.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend losses in 1-3 month window. RBA hawkish bias and rising bond yields cap equity multiples. AUD weakness provides partial offset for miners. Expect volatility around RBA decisions and US-China headlines. Small-cap cap raises create overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Intergenerational Report tax reform may provide fiscal stabilisation. Housing correction likely to complete, supporting eventual rate cuts. Energy transition and data centre demand create structural winners. Geopolitical risk premium persists. ASX recovery contingent on RBA pivot and global growth stabilisation.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (hawkish vs. unemployment data)
AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
Iron ore and copper pricing (China demand signals)
ASX small-cap cap raise completion/dilution events
Housing price data (CoreLogic, SQM) monthly releases
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Iron ore (62% Fe) and copper spot prices
CoreLogic house price index (national and Sydney/Melbourne)
